body: On 2026-09-14, three That Boy Hi Hat tracks were accepted onto the New Rap Hits playlist (673 followers) via Audiartist: Zooted Zone (#25818), Doves & Diamonds (#25820) and Shaka Zulu (#25821). A full scan of the playlist on 2026-09-15 (all 105 tracks) verified all three placements: Shaka Zulu #21, Zooted Zone #30, Doves & Diamonds #31. Two other claimed adds — Flow's 'No Label Needed' claim and Shan/DJ 6Rings' 'It's Goin' claim, both from 2026-09-14 — failed verification in the same window and are carried as claimed-but-unverified, not as wins.
